# Story 8.2: Right-align numeric columns in dms-base-table

Status: in-progress

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want the numbers in every table to be right-aligned,
So that quantities, prices, yields, and gains line up at the right edge of their column and are easy to compare across rows.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. In `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.html`, the body `<mat-cell>` (currently `class="dms-body-cell"`) gains a type-derived class binding so that when `column.type` is `'number'` or `'currency'` the cell also carries `.dms-body-cell--numeric`; text/date/default columns do not.
2. In `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.scss`, a new `.dms-body-cell--numeric` rule right-aligns the cell content (recommended: `display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center;`) so that plain text, currency spans, and `<dms-editable-cell>` inputs all hug the right edge.
3. The change is centralized in the shared component — no per-table template edits are required — and every consumer (global-universe, global-screener, open-positions, sold-positions, dividend-deposits) renders numeric columns right-aligned with no layout regression to text/date columns or the fixed 57px row height.
4. Story 8.1's red-phase unit assertions are unskipped and green under `nx test dms-material`, with no pre-existing regression in the base-table specs.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1: Remove `.skip()` markers from Story 8.1's tests and confirm they fail (red)
  - [ ] 1.1 Un-skip every `it.skip` added by Story 8.1 in the base-table spec(s).
  - [ ] 1.2 Run `nx test dms-material` and confirm the new assertions FAIL while the alignment is not yet implemented.
- [ ] Task 2: Add the type-derived class binding to the body cell (AC: #1)
  - [ ] 2.1 In `base-table.component.html`, extend the `<mat-cell>` so numeric-typed columns get `.dms-body-cell--numeric` — e.g. `[class.dms-body-cell--numeric]="column.type === 'number' || column.type === 'currency'"` (or an equivalent class map in the component).
- [ ] Task 3: Add the right-alignment CSS (AC: #2)
  - [ ] 3.1 In `base-table.component.scss`, add `.dms-body-cell--numeric { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; }` (or an equivalent that right-aligns all content types).
- [ ] Task 4: Verify green + no regression (AC: #3, #4)
  - [ ] 4.1 Re-run `nx test dms-material`; confirm Story 8.1's assertions now pass and no pre-existing base-table or consumer spec regresses.
  - [ ] 4.2 Run `nx run dms-material:lint` and the build target; both clean.

## Dev Notes

- Red-phase TDD convention: this story's FIRST task is to remove Story 8.1's `.skip()` markers, confirm red, then implement until green.
- **Why a class on `<mat-cell>` (not inside `#defaultCell`):** most consumers pass their own `#cellTemplate`, so the internal default-cell switch only covers tables that don't override it. The shared `<mat-cell>` wrapper is the single point that every table's body cell passes through — one change covers all five surfaces.
- **Why flex, not `text-align: right`:** `text-align` does not move block-level children (the `<dms-editable-cell>` input in open-positions/sold-positions/dividend-deposits). A flex container with `justify-content: flex-end` right-aligns inline text, currency spans, and the editable input uniformly. Keep `align-items: center` so content stays vertically centered within the 57px row.
- **Headers stay left-aligned:** only body cells get the class; `<mat-header-cell>` is untouched (matches Story 8.1 AC #3).
- **Verified numeric columns covered** (no per-table edits needed): Universe `distribution`, `distributions_per_year`, `yield_percent`, `avg_purchase_yield_percent`, `last_price` (currency), `most_recent_sell_price` (currency), `position`; Open Positions `buy`/`sell` (currency, editable), `quantity`, `expectedYield`, `lastPrice`, `unrealizedGainPercent`, `unrealizedGain`, `targetGain`, `targetSell`; Sold Positions `buy`/`sell` (currency, editable), `quantity`, `capitalGain` (currency), `capitalGainPercentage`; Dividend Deposits amount (currency).
- **Prose note:** the Epic prose asks for right-alignment "on decimal point where the column is a float rather than an integer." Right-edge alignment of cell content satisfies this in the standard, maintainable sense; true tabular-figure decimal-point alignment would require monospace digits and is out of scope here.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.html` (one class binding on `<mat-cell>`).
- Modify: `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.scss` (new `.dms-body-cell--numeric` rule).
- No conflict: additive class + CSS; existing `.dms-body-cell` rules and the 57px row height are untouched.
